title: 第964章 独享一朵蘑菇云第963章 大成水之真意
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
“大成水之真意？”
密林之中，黑幕翻涌，笼罩着李浪和陈丹求的身躯，默默的跟随在孔渔和孔磊的身后。
而孔渔和孔磊之间的对话，李浪都能通过孔渔脑海之中的清气，感知的清清楚楚。
面容之上，顿时闪烁过一抹异色。
大成水之真意……
这可真是意外之喜了！
可以说，水之真意，才是李浪鬼神纹的本体真意之一，李浪的蝶翼冰霜神龙纹，乃为水与风奥义结合的双鬼神奥义鬼神纹。
若是能够感悟大成水之真意，那对于李浪而言，提升可以说是极其巨大！
甚至，能让他的修为提升速度变得飞快起来！
炼化鬼兽丹的速度，都能增快许多，若是风之真意亦是得获大成，那李浪的修为提升速度，还能更快！
“孔笙感悟的乃是风之大成真意，孔磊感悟的是水之大成真意……”
“真是好兄弟啊，都是散财好童子。”
李浪唇角扬起，心头也不由热切起来，对于感悟这二人的大成真意，已经势在必得，因为，感悟他们的大成真意之后，或许能帮助他的修为快速提升，这点就非常的重要！
李浪闭目，下一瞬，瞳孔之中，顿时浮现出了万千星光，紫极万星瞳开启，除此之外，万星瞳之下，六棱镜滴溜溜转动！
转轮瞳，第三变，六棱镜！
……
……
咻——！
正带着孔渔弛掠的孔磊，突然心头一阵心悸。
那是突破到半步天纹之后，发生蜕变的本源婴胚，所带来的危机感应。

“不对劲。”
孔磊皱眉，他落在地上，面色沉凝，强大的感知扩散开来。
半步天纹层次的感知，自是比地源圆满更为强大，笼罩范围已经能达到了百丈，扩散开来，像是扫描仪般，不住的扫荡而过。
可是，他根本无法查询到那股危机的来源，让他头皮发麻的危机，却不知道来自何方。
“怎么了磊哥？”
孔渔忍不住询问道。
“不知道，心中不知道为何会有些不安……”
孔磊沉声说道。
孔渔闻言，面容上不由浮现出几许惊慌失措：“会不会是黄池带着黄金虎族的顶级妖孽黄飞宇、黄飞鲤他们来寻我们麻烦？”
孔磊闻言，心头微微震动，眸中却是多了几分凝重。
“黄飞宇和黄飞鲤他们若是真的出现，我也不怕，我如今踏足半步天纹，却也未尝不能与他们一战。”
“另外，黄飞宇和黄飞鲤这等存在，若是跟黄池这种垃圾掺和在一起，那真是让人作呕，让人嫌恶，也不配成为顶级妖孽了。”
孔磊声音冰冷，杀机肆虐。
“黄飞宇和黄飞鲤很有可能也突破到半步天纹境了，对我们而言，威胁太大了……”
孔渔有几分害怕，不由的愈发的靠近了孔磊，仿佛在找寻几许安全感般。
“别怕，有我在！”
孔磊心头顿时柔软，伸出手，揽住了孔渔的肩膀。
content_en:
"The true meaning of Dachengshui?"
In the dense forest, darkness surged, covering the bodies of Li Lang and Chen Danqiu, silently following behind Kong Yu and Kong Lei.
As for the conversation between Kong Yu and Kong Lei, Li Lang could clearly perceive it through the clear energy in Kong Yu's mind.
A strange color suddenly flashed across his face.
The true meaning of Dachengshui...
What a surprise!
It can be said that the true meaning of water is one of the true meanings of Li Lang's ghost and god patterns. Li Lang's butterfly wing frost dragon pattern is a double ghost and god pattern that combines the mysteries of water and wind.
If he could understand the true meaning of Dacheng Shui, then for Li Lang, the improvement would be extremely huge!
It can even make his cultivation level increase very quickly!
The speed of refining ghost beast pills can be increased much faster. If the true meaning of the wind is also achieved, then Li Lang's cultivation will be improved even faster!
"Kong Sheng realized the true meaning of wind, and Kong Lei realized the true meaning of water..."
"What good brothers they are. They are both good boys who spread their wealth."
The corners of Li Lang's lips raised, and he couldn't help but feel eager. He was determined to understand the true meaning of these two people, because after understanding their true meaning, it might help him improve his cultivation quickly, which was very important!
Li Lang closed his eyes, and in the next moment, thousands of stars suddenly appeared in his pupils, and the Purple Extreme Ten Thousand Star Pupils opened. In addition, under the Ten Thousand Star Pupils, a hexagonal prism rotated!
Wheel pupil, third transformation, hexagonal prism!
…
…
Phew——!
Kong Lei, who was taking Kong Yuchi for a walk, suddenly felt a palpitation in his heart.
That is the sense of crisis brought about by the transformation of the original infant embryo after breaking through to the half-step sky pattern.
"Something's wrong."
Kong Lei frowned, and he fell to the ground, his face stern, and his powerful perception spread.
The perception of the half-step sky pattern level is naturally more powerful than the perfection of the earth source. The coverage range has reached a hundred feet, spreading out like a scanner, constantly sweeping through.
However, he could not find out the source of the crisis at all. The crisis that made his scalp numb did not know where it came from.
"What's wrong, Brother Lei?"
Kong Yu couldn't help but ask.
"I don't know, I don't know why I feel a little uneasy..."
Kong Lei said in a deep voice.
Hearing this, Kong Yu couldn't help but have a hint of panic on his face: "Could it be that Huang Chi brought Huang Feiyu and Huang Feili, the top monsters of the Golden Tiger Clan, to cause trouble for us?"
When Kong Lei heard this, his heart was slightly shaken, but his eyes were a little more dignified.
"If Huang Feiyu and Huang Feili really show up, I won't be afraid. Now that I have set foot on the half-step sky pattern, I won't be unable to fight with them."
"In addition, if existences like Huang Feiyu and Huang Feili are mixed with garbage like Huang Chi, it will be really disgusting and disgusting, and they are not worthy of being top-notch monsters."
Kong Lei's voice was cold and murderous.
"Huang Feiyu and Huang Feili are very likely to have broken through to the Half-Step Sky Realm. For us, the threat is too great..."
Kong Yu was a little scared and couldn't help but get closer to Kong Lei, as if he was looking for some sense of security.
"Don't be afraid, I'm here!"
Kong Lei's heart suddenly softened, and he stretched out his hand to wrap his arms around Kong Yu's shoulders.
